verseText: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
meaning: We know God is on our side because he sent Jesus to save us. And if God is on our side, no one can defeat us.

recall.question: What does it mean that God is “for us?”

meaning.question: What does “If God is for us, who can be against us?” mean?
choices: If God is on our side, nothing can stop His plans for us
The devil is just as strong as God
God will be on our side if we are good

application.prompt: We can be sure God is on our side. He proved it by sending His Son to save us. And with God on our side, there is no enemy that could stop God' good plan for us. How could remembering what God has done help you face a difficult situation with courage?
